facts.claim: Mulia Bali hosts weddings: its own page says Unity Garden and Mulia Glass House are 'nestled along the beachfront of Nusa Dua' with 'picturesque coastal views'.

Mulia Bali lists wedding packages by guest count on its own site: an Oceanfront Glass House wedding 'for up to 100 guests', an Eden Garden package 'for 100 guests' ('a lush, tropical garden wedding... just steps from the beach'), and a weekday glass chapel wedding listed 'for 200 guests'.
facts.conflicts: Package guest counts are per package, not venue maximums; the 200-guest figure sits on a chapel package, so confirm actual chapel seating.

facts.claim: Mulia Bali names a 'floating glass chapel' (Harmony Chapel is named in the current offer) and says its weekday glass chapel wedding is 'available only through December 2026'; it has a dedicated wedding team contact (Mulia Weddings, wedding@themulia.com).
facts.conflicts: Page names both 'Harmony Chapel' and 'floating glass chapel'; confirm they are the same space and whether chapel ceremonies continue in 2027.

facts.claim: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay describes its wedding venues as 'beautiful botanical gardens', 'romantic private beaches' and 'an elevated hill overlooking the Indian Ocean'.

Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay: Gili Jimbaran is a 'secluded private-island venue' for up to 100 guests; the Pool Terrace has '180-degree ocean views from 35 metres above the sea'; the Imperial Villa (two storeys, infinity pool, dedicated private team) can host wedding, reception and honeymoon in one place.

Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay: Sundara has an over-water aisle across its 57-metre pool. The venue table lists the beachfront Coconut Grove (593 m2) at banquet 210 and reception 250, and the Pool Terrace at reception 220.

Raffles Bali hosts weddings: its weddings page describes 'a ribbon of pristine sand... lapped by the cerulean Indian Ocean' and lists beachfront, garden and private villa venues, with indoor and sheltered options.
Raffles Bali offers ceremonies in its Presidential Villa for an intimate wedding and party of 30 guests, with a wedding arch in the villa's private tropical garden and ocean views.

Raffles Bali 'at a glance' on its weddings page: 32 private villas, 57 acres of grounds, a secluded private beach, a beachside lawn, Raffles Wellbeing Butler Service and private limousine transfers; it notes dedicated wedding planning support.
Grand Hyatt Bali hosts weddings 'from beautifully manicured gardens to a beachfront sanctuary' and claims 'the longest shoreline in the Nusa Dua area'.
facts.conflicts: 'Longest shoreline in Nusa Dua' is the hotel's own claim; attribute it, do not state as fact.

facts.claim: Grand Hyatt Bali: the Grand Ballroom (1,202 sq m, pillar-less) takes up to 1,140 theatre style or 736 seated banquet; the Karangasem ballroom up to 480 theatre or 320 banquet; the outdoor wedding space (1,341 sq m) is listed at 1,500 guests.
Grand Hyatt Bali lists an on-site wedding planner (Wedding Specialist), an in-house florist, exclusive group room rates and complimentary use of the hotel for pre-wedding and family photos.
The Apurva Kempinski Bali hosts weddings: Kimaya Chapel is 'a stunning glass chapel situated in a cliff building' with the Indian Ocean as backdrop and natural light through glass walls.

The Apurva Kempinski Bali says Kimaya Chapel (65 m2, indoor, upper floor) accommodates up to 20 persons; the same page's configuration table lists theatre 50 and banquet 40. A wedding planner is listed under services.
facts.conflicts: Up to 20 (text) vs theatre 50 / banquet 40 (table); confirm ceremony seating.

insider_details.detail: For a beach-and-banquet wedding over 200 guests at Four Seasons Jimbaran Bay, the beachfront Coconut Grove (reception 250) and Pool Terrace (reception 220) are the listed spaces; the private-island Gili Jimbaran caps at 100.
Mulia Bali prices and sizes by package; a package label is not a room capacity, so ask for a seating plan for the chapel before promising guest numbers.
Raffles Bali suits small weddings: the Presidential Villa takes 30 and the resort has 32 villas, so a full buyout of guest accommodation is a realistic question to ask.
Grand Hyatt Bali is the large-guest-list option in Nusa Dua, with a ballroom seating 736 for dinner as a wet-weather fallback to its garden and beach spaces.
Kempinski's Kimaya Chapel is indoor, air-conditioned and on an upper floor, a useful heat and rain plan for elopements and small ceremonies.
